description: MIDI Adapter Configuration for MilkV Duo S

uart_midi.comment: Hardware UART for DIN MIDI output. Default is ttyS4, adjust based on your hardware setup.

network_midi.comment: Network MIDI using RTP-MIDI protocol via aseqnet. Default port is 5004.

gpio_buttons.comment: Example GPIO button configuration. Adjust GPIO number based on your wiring.
Example GPIO button to trigger MIDI reconnection.

routing.comment: Example: Route USB MIDI (14:0) to hardware UART MIDI (20:0). Use 'aconnect -l' to see available ports.
Example: Route USB MIDI (14:0) to network MIDI (128:0).

_notes.gpio_numbers: Use duo-pinmux or WiringX to identify GPIO numbers for your board.
_notes.midi_ports: Run 'aconnect -l' to list available ALSA MIDI ports and their addresses.
_notes.uart_device: Common UART devices: /dev/ttyS0-5. Check your device tree for the correct one.
_notes.network_midi: Clients can connect to <board-ip>:5004 using RTP-MIDI compatible software.
_notes.gpio_setup: Remember to set GPIO direction to 'in' for button inputs.
